metadata.title: Amazon and Intel Tank the AI Trade. One Factor Linking Earnings Flops.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Amazon and Intel Tank the AI Trade. The One Factor Linking Big Tech’s Underwhelming Earnings.
Big Tech earnings are on track to be more of a horror movie than a crowd pleaser. Technology stocks across the market are sinking as investors eye shrinking cash flows across the sector’s largest companies.
